description: Manuscript in a single Gothic hand in red and black ink, the last two leaves in a slightly later hand. Neumatic notation printed in black, on a 4-line staff printed in red. Bound in calf-backed wooden boards, with a chased brass catch lettered AVE. Manual for a Dominican priest concerning the liturgy, music, readings, and performance guidelines for Visitation of the Sick, the Last Rites, and the Matins of the Office of the Dead. The second and longer part of the manuscript presents the canonical liturgy performed on the eve of a funeral, comprising antiphons, versicles and responses, nine readings from the Book of Job, responsories and alternative prayers for men, women, and bishops. A slightly later hand added the prayers and forumals for the Absolution of the Dead. The manuscript concludes with the incipit of the antiphon In paradisum. Latin words. Neumatic notation. Title derived by cataloger.

description: Melody line and text. Last numbered page is 1224, but many pages are not numbered. Includes indexes. "A hymnal in the style of Gather comprehensive with a versatile blend of 70% piano / guitar-based titles and 30% organ-based titles. An insightful collection of the best contemporary titles published since the release of Gather comprehensive, second edition, from today's best composers and a variety of publishers. A substantial number of texts from modern hymn-writers. Shorter songs for worship from the Taizé and Iona Communities, along with more bilingual (English-Spanish) music. Lectionary psalms set to Guimont psalm tones, plus a sampling of additional psalm settings from a variety of composers"--Publisher.
